frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

south.geometry: Actual refined figure pixels and contour retained after background-noise cleanup; no independent body/head/foot rescale.

east.geometry: Actual refined figure pixels and contour retained after background-noise cleanup; no independent body/head/foot rescale.

north.geometry: Actual refined figure pixels and contour retained after background-noise cleanup; no independent body/head/foot rescale.

production_albedo: All RGB neutral grayscale; RGB at alpha0 cleared. Saved alpha is real, no gray halo on actual composite.
color_ownership: Editable curves follow the lower-body transition; arm/hand overrides keep smooth human skin in w. Separate alpha-over planes reconstruct the same neutral figure to <=1 channel value.
head: Head and upper neck separated inside the neck strip; body/head recomposition verified at saved-pixel level.
physical_mapping: Common physical scale and per-facing stance pivots; torso naturally shifts forward in profile while the lower-body footprint pivot stays fixed.
